name: adserver
description: First-party ad-server Worker (kotoba-lang/adnet core) — advertisers bill in USDC via x402.

scripts.build: npm run cljk && kbb -M:cljs:mirror -m shadow.cljs.devtools.cli release worker
scripts.test: kbb --backend sci --classpath src:test test/run_portable.cljk && npm run cljk && kbb -M:cljs:mirror -m shadow.cljs.devtools.cli compile test && node dist/test/test.cjs && kbb --backend sci test/worker_http_test.cljk
